summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its October 2026 delivery update press release. The registrant reported 29,025 vehicles delivered in October 2026, cumulative deliveries of 1,862,676 as of October 31, 2026, and over 3,000 units of the new Li MEGA. The release also described the proprietary Lianshan Battery and Motor, the October 28 launch of the 2026 Li i6, an upcoming OTA 9.2 rollout, and network metrics of 481 retail stores and 4,206 super charging stations. No transaction, shareholder action, or structural event is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary operational update.
